items.title: Introducing AI Futures
items.content: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
items.contentSnippet: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

summaries.zh: OpenAI推出新博客“AI Futures”，旨在探讨变革性AI如何重塑权力、治理、经济和个人自由。
summaries.en: OpenAI has launched a new blog titled "AI Futures." The platform is dedicated to exploring the potential societal impacts of transformative artificial intelligence. Its focus areas include how AI could reshape power dynamics, governance structures, the economy, and individual freedom. The blog serves as a space to discuss these broad, forward-looking implications.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.content: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.contentSnippet: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

summaries.zh: Stampli 在固定截止日期且设计资源被占用的情况下，利用 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 将原本需数周的上线筹备工作压缩至数天完成。这一案例展示了人工智能工具在加速产品从构想到市场落地过程中的实际作用。
summaries.en: Stampli accelerated its product launch timeline by using Codex and ChatGPT Work. Facing a fixed deadline and with design resources already assigned elsewhere, the team compressed what would have taken weeks of launch production into just days. The tools enabled faster execution and helped move ideas to market more efficiently, despite internal constraints. The case highlights how AI-assisted workflows can streamline production when time and resources are limited.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.content: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

summaries.zh: OpenAI重申，符合条件的API客户可继续享受零数据保留（Zero Data Retention）政策。同时，公司预览了“私密安全处理”（Private Safety Processing）功能，旨在推进前沿模型的安全保障，同时不损害数据隐私。该举措在强化AI安全性的同时，确保客户数据不会被存储或用于训练，兼顾合规与隐私保护需求。
summaries.en: OpenAI has reaffirmed its commitment to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible API customers, ensuring their data is not stored. The company also previews a new initiative called Private Safety Processing, designed to enhance advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy. This approach reportedly allows safety measures to be applied while maintaining strict privacy standards for users. The announcement highlights OpenAI’s ongoing effort to balance robust AI safeguards with customer data protection.

items.summary: OpenAI重申，符合条件的API客户可继续享受零数据保留（Zero Data Retention）政策。同时，公司预览了“私密安全处理”（Private Safety Processing）功能，旨在推进前沿模型的安全保障，同时不损害数据隐私。该举措在强化AI安全性的同时，确保客户数据不会被存储或用于训练，兼顾合规与隐私保护需求。

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
items.content: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.
items.contentSnippet: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

summaries.zh: ChatGPT Ads正扩展至31个欧洲市场。该广告服务将帮助广告主在用户探索信息、比较选项及做出决策的过程中触达受众。此举旨在覆盖更广泛的欧洲用户群体，为品牌提供在AI对话场景中投放广告的机会。目前官方尚未公布具体上线时间及更多细节。
summaries.en: ChatGPT Ads is expanding into 31 European markets. The expansion allows advertisers to connect with users at key stages of their decision-making journey, including when they are exploring options, comparing alternatives, and making final choices. The rollout extends the platform's advertising reach across a broader European audience, enabling brands to engage potential customers during these critical moments of consideration and selection.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.content: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

summaries.zh: OpenAI启动一项新计划，旨在加强国家安全领域人工智能的民主监督。该计划将为政府机构提供工具、培训及专业知识支持，帮助其更好地理解和监管AI技术在国家安全的运用。此举措体现了对AI治理和问责机制的重视。
summaries.en: OpenAI has launched a new initiative aimed at strengthening democratic oversight of artificial intelligence in national security contexts. The program supports government institutions by providing tools, training, and specialized expertise. Its focus is to help ensure that AI use in national security remains under democratic control and accountability. The initiative reflects an effort to bridge technical knowledge and governance in a sensitive field.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.content: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与CodeAI宣布合作，旨在帮助学生建立AI素养，培养对AI的批判性思维，并掌握负责任地使用和塑造AI的技能。此次合作聚焦于为“第一代AI”人才做好准备，强调在AI时代中，学生不仅需要理解技术，更需具备判断力与伦理意识。双方将共同推动相关教育资源的开发与应用。
summaries.en: OpenAI and CodeAI have announced a partnership aimed at preparing students for an AI-driven world. The collaboration focuses on building AI literacy, encouraging critical thinking about AI, and helping students develop the skills needed to use and shape AI responsibly. By working together, the two organizations intend to equip the first generation of students with a strong foundation in understanding and engaging with artificial intelligence.

items.contentSnippet: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

items.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
items.content: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.
items.contentSnippet: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

summaries.zh: 《The builder's guide to GPT-5.6》一文介绍了初创企业如何利用GPT-5.6构建更快、更具成本效益的AI代理。文章重点涵盖两大方面：一是通过更智能的模型选择来优化性能与成本；二是借助新的Responses API功能提升开发效率。这些能力帮助开发者在构建AI代理时获得更优的性价比与灵活性。
summaries.en: This guide explains how startups can leverage GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents. It focuses on two key elements: smarter model selection to optimize performance and spending, and the capabilities of the new Responses API. The article provides practical strategies for developers to improve agent efficiency and reduce costs by choosing the right models for specific tasks and utilizing the latest API features effectively.

items.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
items.content: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.

This marks a transition from experimental use to practical, execution-focused deployment in business operations.

items.title: What building an AI-native finance function taught me
items.content: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.

summaries.zh: OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar分享了构建AI原生财务部门的五个经验，涵盖自动化预测、强化内控与衡量AI投资回报率等方面。她强调AI不仅能提升效率，还能改善财务管控机制，并指出财务领导者需主动推动AI落地，同时建立清晰的评估框架。总结聚焦于AI在财务职能中的实际应用与价值创造。
summaries.en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares key lessons from building an AI-native finance function. The insights cover using AI for automated forecasting, strengthening financial controls, and measuring AI’s return on investment. Her experience highlights practical applications of AI in finance, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and governance. The article distills these into five core lessons for leaders adopting AI in financial operations.

items.title: Expanding Daybreak as the Cyber Defense Window Narrows
items.content: Meet GPT-5.6-Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity-specific model available through Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing.
items.contentSnippet: Meet GPT-5.6-Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity-specific model available through Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing.

summaries.zh: OpenAI 推出网络安全专用模型 GPT-5.6-Cyber，可通过 Daybreak Red 平台使用，用于授权的漏洞研究、漏洞验证和安全测试。文章标题指出，在“网络防御窗口”不断收窄的背景下，Daybreak 正在扩展其能力。该模型旨在支持安全专业人员更高效地开展防御工作，但仅限合法授权场景使用。整体强调在日益紧张的网络安全环境中，引入专业化工具以强化主动防御。
summaries.en: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.6-Cyber, a cybersecurity-specific model now available through Daybreak Red. It is designed for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing. The launch comes as the window for proactive cyber defense narrows, underscoring the need for expanding defensive capabilities. The model aims to support security professionals in identifying and addressing threats within authorized contexts.

The example highlights how AI can be applied to practical marketing workflows for measurable gains.

summaries.en: OpenAI has released preliminary cybersecurity evaluations for Astra, its advanced AI model, outlining initial findings. OpenAI emphasizes the importance of continuous evaluation and reinforcement of security measures to keep pace with potential threats.
